info.title: eCardWidget Developer API
info.description:
Build with eCardWidget: **send eCards** programmatically and **keep your team-member directory
in sync** from your own systems (HR/HRIS, CRM, donation platforms, internal tools). These are
the same endpoints that power the official **Zapier** integration — so you can build a direct
integration or use Zapier, whichever fits.

# Quick start

1. Grab your **API key** from the dashboard → **Settings → Developers → API Keys**.
2. Send every request with it as a Bearer token:
   ```
   Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
   ```
3. Find a widget + eCard to send (`GET /pub/ecard-actions/get-ecards`), then send it
   (`POST /pub/ecard-actions/send-ecard`).

```bash
# List the eCards in a widget
curl "https://app.ecardwidget.com/v2/api/pub/ecard-actions/get-ecards?widgetId=WIDGET_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ECW_API_KEY"
```

# Authentication

All endpoints authenticate with your account **API key** as a Bearer token. Keys are shown in
full only once at creation (store it safely), are labeled so you can tell integrations apart,
and can be revoked anytime. **Every request is scoped to the account that owns the key** — you
can only read or modify your own widgets, eCards, and directory (full tenant isolation).

# Conventions

- **Base URL:** `https://app.ecardwidget.com/v2/api`
- **IDs are "vanity IDs"** — short opaque strings like `e4xgrzltk` (eCard), `w6v62rn95yq`
  (widget), `s2k7zqpvnll272r` (a sent/shared card). Treat them as opaque; don't parse them.
- **Dates** accept common formats (`YYYY-MM-DD`, `M/D/YYYY`, ISO 8601). Birthdays are stored
  year-masked for privacy.

# Response shapes

Most endpoints return the **standard envelope**:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { }, "messages": [] }
```
- `success` — boolean.
- `data` — object or array (endpoint-specific). List endpoints add a `meta` object (pagination).
- `messages` — human-readable strings (errors/info).

> ⚠️ **One exception:** `POST /pub/ecard-actions/send-ecard` returns a **flat** object (result
> fields at the top level, no `data` wrapper) so integrators can map fields directly.

# Errors

Standard HTTP status codes; failures include `success: false` and a `messages` array.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `400` | Bad request — missing/invalid parameter |
| `401` | Missing or invalid API key |
| `403` | Authenticated, but the API key isn't allowed here (out of scope, or a dashboard-only action) |
| `404` | Not found, or not owned by your account |
| `422` | Validation failed (e.g. required custom fields) |
| `429` | Rate limited — back off and retry |

# Rate limits

Each API key is limited to **120 requests per minute** (fixed 1-minute windows). Exceeding it
returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header (seconds to wait). Higher limits are available per
account on request. For a first-time bulk load of an entire employee base, use the in-app
**spreadsheet importer**, then use this API for ongoing deltas.

# Key permissions (scopes)

An API key can be **scoped** to specific feature areas (eCards, Directory, Gift Cards, …), each at
`manage`, `view`, or `none`, from **Settings → Developers → API Keys** (editable any time). An
unscoped key has full account access. A request outside a key's scope returns `403` naming the
blocked area. Key/webhook **credential management** (creating/editing keys, rotating the signing
secret) is dashboard-only and cannot be performed with an API key.

Scoping + the rate limit apply to this **Bearer** API. The Zapier integration's `/zapier/*` param-key
endpoints are intentionally **not scope-restricted or rate-limited** (a Zapier connection works with
any key), though key usage there still updates the key's "Last used".

# Versioning & stability

The API is **URL-major-versioned** (`/v2/`). Within a major version we make only **additive,
backward-compatible** changes — new endpoints, new optional request fields, and new response
fields. Within `/v2/` we will **not** remove or rename a field, change its type or meaning, or
make an optional field required. Build defensively: **ignore unknown response fields** so
additions never break you.

Each operation carries an **`x-stability`** marker:

| Level | Contract |
|---|---|
| `stable` | Backed by the additive-only guarantee above. The default. |
| `preview` | Newer / actively evolving — may change without notice. Depend on it cautiously. |

When a breaking change is truly unavoidable we ship a new major version (`/v3/`) and keep the
previous one for **at least 18 months**. Deprecated endpoints return `Deprecation: true` and a
`Sunset: <RFC 8594 date>` response header, and are flagged `deprecated: true` in this spec.

get.description:
Returns the enabled eCards in a widget, with their names, HTML bodies, and image URLs.
Use the returned `ecardid` (and the `widgetId` you passed) with **Send eCard**.

post.summary: Send, schedule, or share an eCard
post.description:
Sends an eCard one of three ways:

- **Email now** — the default. Emails the eCard to `recipientEmail`.
- **Schedule** — set a *future* `sendAt`; it sends automatically at that time.
- **Share link** — set `type` to `ecard_copy_link` (or `is_sharing: true`). Instead of
  emailing, it creates a viewable eCard and returns a **`shareUrl`** you can route anywhere
  (Slack, SMS, a CRM note). No email is sent, so `recipientEmail` is optional in this mode.

**Required:** `ecardId`, `senderEmail`, `senderName`, `recipientName`. `recipientEmail` is
required for email sends and optional for share links.

> This endpoint returns a **flat** object (no `data` envelope). Email sends include
> `emailsSent`; share sends include `statVanityId` + `shareUrl`.

x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST https://app.ecardwidget.com/v2/api/pub/ecard-actions/send-ecard \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ECW_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "ecardId": "e4xgrzltk",
    "senderEmail": "development@acme.org", "senderName": "Acme Foundation",
    "recipientName": "Jordan", "recipientEmail": "jordan@example.com",
    "personalMessage": "Thank you for your support!"
  }'

200.description: Sent, scheduled, or share link generated

get.description:
Search and page through the eCard designs in your account.

> **In active development (beta).** Authenticate with your **API key** as a Bearer
> token (`Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`), the same as every other endpoint. For a lighter,
> widget-scoped listing, use `GET /pub/ecard-actions/get-ecards` instead.

parameters.name: includeCampaign
parameters.description: Include eCards from campaign widgets (excluded by default)

post.summary: Create or update a team member
post.description:
Adds a member, or updates them if they already exist.

- **PATCH semantics** — only the fields you send change; omitted fields are left untouched,
  so a partial sync never blanks existing data. To clear a field, send it as an empty string.
- **Matching** — by default members match by `email`. To survive email changes, send a stable
  `employee_id` and set `match_field: employee_id`; then an email change updates the same
  person instead of creating a duplicate.
- **Departments** auto-create by name; **manager** is linked by email (resolves on a later
  sync if the manager isn't in the directory yet).
- Use **`dry_run: true`** to validate field mappings and see the would-be action without saving.

stableId.summary: Match by employee ID (survives email changes)

200.description: Member created/updated (or would-be action for a dry run)

get.description: Looks up a single member by `email` or `employee_id`. `data` is empty when not found.

200.description: The member (or empty when not found)

get.description:
Pages through your directory — use it to **reconcile**: periodically list members, diff
against your source system, and `deactivate` anyone no longer present (the streaming-safe
replacement for a spreadsheet "Sync" that deletes everyone not in the file).

Paginate with the **cursor**: pass the previous page's `meta.next_after_id` as `after_id`
until `meta.has_more` is `false`. Use `updated_since` for delta pulls.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: ISO datetime — only members changed since then.

post.description:
Reversibly deactivates a member by `email` or `employee_id`. They stop receiving automated
cards and **no longer count toward your seat limit**, but their record and history are kept.
Use this for normal offboarding; reactivate to restore (subject to seat availability).
Reactivates a previously deactivated member by `email` or `employee_id` (needs an available seat).

post.summary: Permanently delete a team member (GDPR erasure)
post.description:
**Irreversible.** Permanently removes a member and their data — for GDPR erasure only.
For normal offboarding use **Deactivate** instead.

get.description:
Returns the fields you can set on a member — standard fields plus your account's active
**custom date fields** — each with a `label`, `type`, whether it's `required`, and the
accepted `format`. Use this to drive field mapping in your integration.
Returns your account's departments. (Departments are also auto-created by name on upsert.)

Returns a single representative member-change event for the given `event_type`. This is a
helper the **Zapier** integration uses to populate sample data and field mappings in the Zap
editor — it isn't needed for normal API integrations.

200.description: A one-item array containing a sample member-change event.

post.description:
Registers a `hookUrl` to receive a signed JSON `POST` whenever the chosen `event_type`
happens. Returns a subscription `id` (use it to unsubscribe).

**Event types:** `team_member_created`, `team_member_updated`, `team_member_deactivated`,
`team_member_deleted`. `team_member_updated` fires **only on a real change** (idempotent
re-syncs don't notify). The initial spreadsheet import does **not** emit events.

**Delivery & signing:** each delivery is signed with your account's webhook secret
(`X-ECW-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256>`, signed value `<t>.<raw body>`) and retried on failure. De-duplicate
with the payload's `event_id`. See the `WebhookDelivery` schema for the payload shape.
Removes a subscription by the `id` returned from subscribe.

get.description: Paginated list of your automations. Requires the `automations` key scope.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Matches automation name, from-name, or from-email.

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: One of: birthday, anniversary, holiday, fixed_date, custom_field, rule_based, onboarding.

get.description: The full configuration for one automation, including its milestones (offsets/schedule).

post.description: Turn an automation on or off. Enabling validates the configuration first.

get.description: Your reward configuration (provider mode, per-card bounds, velocity enforcement flag). Requires the `gift_cards` key scope.
The reward brands/products available to your account (Giftbit catalog, or the brands in your manual pool).

Reward orders across all send surfaces (widget, campaign, automation). Reward codes/links are
masked. Do NOT pass `ownerid`/`user_id` — the account is derived from your key.

Configured spend guardrails and current usage. Read-only via API (changes are OTP-gated in the
dashboard). Usage is tracked regardless of enforcement — check
`getSettings.velocity_limits_enabled` to know whether limits are actually applied.
Remaining manual reward codes by brand/denomination. Use to alert before a pool runs dry.
Aggregate reward metrics (counts/totals by status, claim rate, spend). Pair with listOrders for detail.

Returns the **calling API key's own** capabilities — which feature areas it can read/write, the
request rate limit, and usage this hour. Safe and non-sensitive: it never returns the key value,
any other key, or account PII beyond the owner's own display name. Any valid key can call it
regardless of scope (an all-`none` key still reads its own info).

The `permissions` map resolves all 12 feature areas to `none` / `view` / `manage`; `capabilities`
flattens that to `"<area>:read"` / `"<area>:write"` strings. `full_access: true` (a legacy/unscoped
key) means `manage` everywhere.

full_access.description: true = legacy/unscoped key with manage everywhere

is_session.description: true if called with a dashboard session instead of a key

permissions.description: Each of the 12 feature areas → its level.

get.description: Paginated list of your widgets. Requires the `widgets` key scope.
The full configuration for one widget, including its parsed `wconfig`.

post.description: Create a widget (send `widget.id: 0`) or update one (send its real `widget.id`). The `widget.name` and `widget.wconfig` fields are always required — `wconfig` is the widget's display/behavior config object and is stored as JSON. On create, the server assigns `id`, `vanity_id`, and `ownerid`. Disabling `dir_sender_must_be_in_directory` on an existing widget is OTP-gated (pass `otp_confirmation_token`). Requires the `widgets: manage` scope.

ecardPrices.description: Optional map of `ecardId → price` to update per-eCard prices on this widget.

otp_confirmation_token.description: Required only when disabling `dir_sender_must_be_in_directory` on an existing widget.

x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST https://app.ecardwidget.com/v2/api/widget/save \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ECW_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"widget":{"id":0,"name":"Team Thank-You Cards","wconfig":{"locale":"en"}}}'

post.description: Permanently delete one or more widgets (and their eCards). A widget that is **in use** — attached to automations or campaigns, or with send history — cannot be deleted over the API: the response is `403` with `requires_otp` and an `impact` summary, and the deletion must be confirmed in the dashboard. Requires the `widgets: manage` scope.

otp_confirmation_token.description: Dashboard-issued confirmation token, required when a widget is in use.

403.description: In use — confirm the deletion in the dashboard.

post.description: Create a new widget by duplicating an existing one, copying its settings and (optionally a capped number of) its eCards. The copy is named `Copy - <source name>`. Requires the `widgets: manage` scope.

limit.description: Optional cap on how many eCards to copy (default: all).

get.description: The full configuration for one eCard design. Requires the `ecards` key scope.

post.description: Create an eCard (omit `myEcard.id`) or update one (send its real `myEcard.id`). `myEcard.name` is required and every eCard belongs to a widget via `myEcard.widgetid`. Supply artwork **either** as a public URL (`myEcard.self_hosted_url`) **or** a base64 blob in the top-level `ecardimg` field (raw or `data:` URI) — the blob is uploaded and stored as the cover image. `myEcard.details` is the eCard body HTML (sanitized server-side). Requires the `ecards: manage` scope.

ecardimg.description: Optional eCard image as base64 (raw or `data:image/...;base64,` URI). Alternative to `myEcard.self_hosted_url`.

post.description: Permanently delete one or more eCards. An eCard that is in use may require confirmation in the dashboard (`403` with `requires_otp`). Requires the `ecards: manage` scope.
Copy an eCard (its design + image). By default the copy lands in the source eCard's widget; pass `widgetid` to place it in a different widget you own. Requires the `ecards: manage` scope.

widgetid.description: Optional target widget id (default: the source's widget).

post.summary: Bulk-update one field across a widget's eCards
post.description: Set a single whitelisted field to the same value across every eCard in a widget (or an explicit `ecardids` list). Allowed `fieldName` values: `name`, `emailSubject`, `header`, `details`, `ecardLink`, `url_redirect_after_send`, `disabled`, `canSchedule`, `ecardbrandid`, `ecard_mode`, `envelope_bg_image_url`, `envelope_color_settings`, `envelope_auto_open`, `envelope_confetti`, `envelope_audio_url`, `envelope_video_url`. Campaign-backed widgets are rejected. Requires the `ecards: manage` scope.

widgetid.description: Apply to all eCards in this widget.

ecardids.description: Or apply to these specific eCard ids.

fieldName.description: The whitelisted field to set (see list above).

fieldValue.description: The value to set on every targeted eCard.

post.description: Set the display order of eCards within a widget. Requires the `ecards: manage` scope.

neworder.description: eCard ids in the desired order.

post.description: Upload a base64 image and get back a hosted URL you can reference from an eCard (e.g. as `self_hosted_url`, or inside `details` HTML). Requires the `ecards: manage` scope.
Render a preview of an eCard with optional merge-tag values and property overrides, without sending anything. Requires the `ecards` key scope.

overrideProps.description: Ad-hoc property overrides for the preview.

get.description: Paginated list of your campaigns. Requires the `campaigns` key scope.
The full configuration for one campaign, including its counts and schedule.

post.description: Create a campaign (omit `campaign.id`) or update one (send its real `campaign.id`). Creating a campaign yields a **draft** — it does not send. `campaign_name` is required. After saving, attach eCards (`/campaign/saveCampaignEcards`) and recipients (`/campaign/saveRecipients`), then `/campaign/schedule` or `/campaign/send`. Requires the `campaigns: manage` scope.
Set which eCards the campaign sends. Requires the `campaigns: manage` scope.
Set the campaign's recipients from directory members (`directoryMemberIds`) and/or an array of CSV rows (`csvRecipients`). Requires the `campaigns: manage` scope.
Parse a recipient CSV (raw content in `csvContent`) into rows you can pass to /campaign/saveRecipients. Requires the `campaigns: manage` scope.

csvContent.description: Raw CSV text (with a header row).

get.description: The recipients currently attached to a campaign. Requires the `campaigns` key scope.

post.description: Schedule the campaign to send at a future time. Sets status to `scheduled`. Requires the `campaigns: manage` scope.

Send the campaign to all its recipients immediately. **Gift-card campaigns are OTP-gated**: if `gift_card_enabled` is set, the request must include a dashboard-issued `gc_confirmation_token`, otherwise it returns `403` with `requires_otp` and must be sent from the dashboard. Requires the `campaigns: manage` scope.

403.description: Gift-card confirmation required — send from the dashboard.

messages: Gift card confirmation required. Please verify with OTP before sending.

post.description: Set the render language for the campaign's eCards. Requires the `campaigns: manage` scope.
Delete a campaign. This action is **OTP-gated**: over the API a key receives `403` with `requires_otp`, and the deletion must be confirmed in the dashboard. Requires the `campaigns: manage` scope.

403.description: OTP required — confirm the deletion in the dashboard.

post.description: Create an automation (omit `automation.id`) or update one (send its real `automation.id`; sending only `id` + `enabled` performs a partial enable/disable). `automation_name` and `event_type` are required on create. The JSON fields `trigger_config`, `timing_config`, `random_messages`, `selected_ecard_ids`, `selected_member_ids`, `selected_department_ids`, and `milestone_rules` are sent as objects/arrays. Creating a **gift-card** automation is OTP-gated in the dashboard. Requires the `automations: manage` scope.

gc_confirmation_token.description: Required only when creating/enabling a gift-card automation.

post.description: Delete an automation. This action is **OTP-gated**: over the API a key receives `403` with `requires_otp`, and the deletion must be confirmed in the dashboard. Requires the `automations: manage` scope.

403.description: OTP required — confirm the deletion in the dashboard.

post.description: Resolve the next firing dates for a trigger/timing config without saving — useful to validate a rule before creating the automation. Requires the `automations` key scope.
Set the eCards used for an automation's manager/department/segment notifications. Requires the `automations: manage` scope.

get.description: The notification eCards configured for an automation. Requires the `automations` key scope.

post.description: Remove the notification eCards for an automation. Requires the `automations: manage` scope.

bearerAuth.description: Your account API key, from **Settings → Developers → API Keys**. Keys may be **scoped** per feature area (manage / view / none); an unscoped key has full account access. Requests outside a key's scope return `403` naming the blocked area, and the per-key limit is 120 req/min (`429` + `Retry-After` when exceeded).

RateLimited.description: Too many requests — the per-key rate limit (120/min) was exceeded.

messages: Rate limit exceeded — this API key allows 120 requests per minute. Retry after 12 seconds.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but this API key isn't allowed here (out of scope, or a dashboard-only action).

messages: This API key doesn't have access to Directory (Team Members).

NotFound.description: Not found, or not owned by your account

messages: eCard not found or you don't have permission to access it

Envelope.description: Standard response envelope used by most endpoints.

Wconfig.description: Widget display/behavior config, stored as JSON in the `wconfig` column. Sent as an object on `POST /widget/save`. All keys optional; unknown keys are preserved. Boolean-ish keys accept true/false.

locale.description: Widget UI language (e.g. en, spanish, french).

ecardsPerPage.description: eCards shown per page in the gallery.

directoryOfferAllMembers.description: Offer all directory members as recipients.

directoryAllowManualEntry.description: Allow typing a recipient not in the directory.

directoryLimitToSelectedMembers.description: Restrict recipients to a chosen subset.

limitEmailsPerSession.description: Max sends per sender session (0 = unlimited).

readReceiptEnabled.description: Notify the sender when the eCard is opened.

personalMessageOptional.description: Make the sender's personal message optional.

WidgetInput.description: A widget's full settable surface for `POST /widget/save`. Fields are grouped below by subsystem. Boolean flags are stored as `0`/`1` (the API also accepts `true`/`false`). Fields marked read-only are returned by the API but ignored on input.

id.description: **Required.** `0` creates a new widget; a real id updates that widget.

name.description: **Required.** Widget name (plain text; HTML is stripped).

widget_type.description: Widget kind; normally blank. `campaign` marks a campaign-backing widget.

merge_tag_defaults.description: System merge-tag fallback values (e.g. `{recipient_name: 'friend'}`), stored as JSON.

custom_fields_preset_id.description: Attach a custom-fields preset you own (0/empty = none).

allow_custom_base64_image.description: Allow senders to upload a custom base64 image.

public_share_enabled.description: Allow public sharing of sent eCards.

page_css.description: Custom CSS for the landing page.

widgetcss.description: Custom CSS injected into the widget.

recipientDomainWhitelist.description: Newline/comma list of allowed recipient email domains.

sender_login_enabled.description: Require a sender login before sending.

dir_on.description: Enable the team directory for this widget.

dir_sender_must_be_in_directory.description: Restrict senders to directory members. Disabling this on an existing widget is OTP-gated.

dir_force_sso.description: Require directory SSO (mutually exclusive with dir_sso_disabled).

dir_sso_disabled.description: Turn directory SSO off (cannot be set with dir_force_sso).

dir_passwords_on.description: Require a password for directory access.

dir_mgr_sender_bcc_on.description: BCC the manager on sender emails.

dir_mgr_recipient_bcc_on.description: BCC the manager on recipient emails.

ecomm_type.description: eCommerce mode (e.g. donation, product); blank = off.

gift_card_enabled.description: Offer gift cards on this widget (requires BYOK).

gift_card_product_ids.description: JSON/list of provider product ids/brands offered.

EcardInput.description: An eCard's settable surface for `POST /ecard/save` (sent as `myEcard`). Every eCard belongs to a widget (`widgetid`). Artwork is set via `self_hosted_url` (URL) or the sibling top-level `ecardimg` base64 field — not via the read-only `cover_image`. Fields marked read-only are returned but ignored on input.

id.description: Omit to create; send a real id to update that eCard.

ecardbrandid.description: Brand id; defaults to your account brand if omitted.

emailSubject.description: Subject line used when the eCard is emailed.

disabled.description: Hide this eCard from the widget gallery.

self_hosted_url.description: Public image URL for the eCard (validated as a URL).

cover_image.description: Stored cover-image path; set by uploading `ecardimg`, not directly.

envelope_color_settings.description: Envelope color tuning (contrast/saturation/hue), stored as JSON.

ecardLinkAltText.description: Alt/label text for the eCard link.

url_redirect_after_send.description: Redirect the sender here after sending.

og_title.description: Open Graph title for shared links.

og_description.description: Open Graph description for shared links.

thumbnail_alt_label.description: Accessibility alt text for the thumbnail.

personalMessageBox.description: Show the sender a personal-message box.

canSchedule.description: Allow the sender to schedule delivery.

predefinedScheduleForced.description: Force the predefined schedule (sender can't change it).

publishOn.description: Make the eCard available on this date.

expireOn.description: Retire the eCard on this date.

customFieldsConfig.description: Canvas custom-fields configuration (items[], etc.). Field names may not start with `preset_`.

CampaignInput.description: A campaign's settable surface for `POST /campaign/save` (sent as `campaign`). Creating a campaign yields a draft; eCards, recipients, scheduling and sending are separate calls. Fields marked read-only are returned but ignored on input.

id.description: Omit to create; send a real id to update.

from_name.description: Sender display name on the emails.

personal_message.description: Default personal message included with each send.

scheduled_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the scheduled send.

gift_card_enabled.description: Attach a gift card to the campaign (sending is then OTP-gated).

gift_card_product_name.description: Provider product/brand label (must match the reward pool).

AutomationInput.description: An automation's settable surface for `POST /automation/save` (sent as `automation`). JSON fields (`trigger_config`, `timing_config`, `random_messages`, `selected_ecard_ids`, `selected_member_ids`, `selected_department_ids`) are sent as objects/arrays. Fields marked read-only are ignored on input.

id.description: Omit to create; send a real id to update. `id` + `enabled` alone = partial toggle.

is_default.description: Mark as the account's default automation for this type.

trigger_type.description: How the fire date is computed.

trigger_config.description: Trigger rule/date config (shape depends on trigger_type), stored as JSON.

random_messages.description: Pool of messages to pick from randomly.

gift_card_enabled.description: Attach a gift card (creating/enabling is OTP-gated).

gift_card_product_name.description: Provider product/brand label (must match the reward pool).

ecardid.description: eCard vanity ID — pass this to Send eCard

recipientEmail.description: Required for email sends. Optional/ignored for share links (type=ecard_copy_link).

personalMessage.description: Optional personal note; basic HTML allowed.

type.description: email (default) emails it; ecard_copy_link returns a shareUrl instead of emailing.

sendAt.description: Leave blank to send now; a FUTURE value schedules the send.

locale.description: Language the eCard renders in. These are the supported render locales; an unlisted value isn't rejected — it falls back to the default (en).

opennotification.description: Notify the sender when the eCard is opened

mergeTags.description: Key/value pairs that fill custom fields / merge tags in the eCard.

SendEcardResult.description: Flat result (no envelope). Email sends include emailsSent; share sends include statVanityId + shareUrl.

scheduled.description: True when a future sendAt scheduled it

sendAt.description: The scheduled time (blank when sent immediately)

statVanityId.description: Share mode only — the shared card's vanity ID

employee_id.description: Stable external ID (recommended for HR syncs)

manager_email.description: Linked to an existing member by email

date_of_birth.description: Birthday — year is privacy-masked; accepts YYYY-MM-DD, M/D/YYYY, …

active.description: false deactivates, true reactivates; OMIT to leave unchanged (upsert never silently reactivates).

mode.description: add_new_only skips members that already exist.

skip_if_missing_required.description: Skip (don't error) rows missing first_name/email. Invalid emails still error.

dry_run.description: Validate and report the would-be action without saving.

additionalProperties.description: custom_date_1..N are also accepted — discover them via GET /fields.

action.description: Sending active:false sets the member inactive but the action is still created/updated; deactivated/reactivated/deleted come from those dedicated endpoints.

changed_fields.description: Fields that actually changed (drives the updated webhook).

warnings.description: Non-fatal notes (e.g. manager not found yet).

MemberSummary.description: The member shape returned by find/list (a summary). The fuller object — with job title, departments, dates, manager — is delivered in member-change webhooks (see Member).

Member.description: Full member object as delivered in member-change webhook payloads.

manager_id.description: Numeric id of the member's manager, if linked.

WebhookDelivery.description:
The signed JSON body POSTed to your `hookUrl`. Header `X-ECW-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>` is the
HMAC-SHA256 of `<t>.<raw body>` using your account's webhook secret — verify it (and reject
timestamps older than ~5 minutes) before trusting.

event_id.description: Stable id — use for de-duplication across retries

source.description: Where the change originated (use to avoid sync loops)

EcardSharedWebhook.description:
The `ecard_shared` webhook body (a JSON **array** of these is POSTed to your dashboard Webhook
URL with header `User-Agent: eCardWidget Hook`) whenever an eCard is sent/shared. For pending
email sends the hook fires before dispatch (`sent: false`); immediate share/social sends arrive
with `sent: true`. Use `scheduled_to_be_sent_at` for the expected send time.

type.description: Share method: email, facebook, twitter, linkedin, sms, whatsapp, …

sent.description: false for pending email sends (hook fires pre-dispatch); true for immediate share/social sends

tags.name: eCards
tags.description:
List the eCards available in a widget, then send one by **email**, **schedule** it for a
future time, or generate a **shareable link** (no email).

tags.name: eCard Search
tags.description:
Search/page your eCard designs. **Actively evolving (beta).** Authenticate with your
**API key** as a Bearer token, the same as every other endpoint. For a lighter, widget-scoped
listing, use `GET /pub/ecard-actions/get-ecards`.

tags.name: Widgets
tags.description:
Full lifecycle for widgets — search, fetch, **create**, **update**, **duplicate**, and
**delete**. A widget is the container that holds eCards and all send/branding/eCommerce/directory
settings. Create and update use the same `POST /widget/save` (id `0` creates, a real id updates).
Deleting a widget that's in use (attached to automations/campaigns or with send history) is
OTP-gated in the dashboard. Requires the `widgets` key scope.

tags.name: Campaigns
tags.description:
Full lifecycle for campaigns — list, fetch, **create/update** (`POST /campaign/save`), attach
eCards and recipients, **schedule**, **send**, and **delete**. Sending a gift-card campaign, and
deleting a campaign, are OTP-gated in the dashboard. Requires the `campaigns` key scope.

tags.name: Directory Sync
tags.description:
Create, update, find, list, deactivate, and permanently delete team-member (directory)
records — the people your automated cards and campaigns target. Designed for streaming
one-record-at-a-time syncs from HR/CRM systems (PATCH semantics, stable-ID matching).

tags.name: Field discovery
tags.description: Discover the fields and departments you can map when syncing members.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description:
Subscribe to directory changes (member created / updated / deactivated / deleted) to push
updates back into your own systems. Deliveries are signed and retried.

tags.name: Automations
tags.description:
List, inspect, preview, and enable/disable your automations (birthday, anniversary, holiday,
fixed-date, and rule-based auto-sends). Creating/deleting reward automations is OTP-gated in the
dashboard. Requires the `automations` key scope.

tags.name: Gift Cards & Rewards
tags.description:
Read-only reporting for your reward program — orders, analytics, available products, manual-pool
inventory, and spend limits. Rewards are *sent* via a widget/campaign/automation; all lifecycle
mutations (cancel, rescind, reveal, limit changes) are OTP-gated in the dashboard. Requires the
`gift_cards` key scope.

tags.name: Introspection
tags.description:
Discover what the calling API key is allowed to do — its per-area permission levels, a flattened
read/write capability list, the request rate limit, and current usage. Powers the
[eCardWidget MCP server](https://github.com/eCardWidget/ecardwidget-mcp) (which registers only the tools a
key is scoped for) and lets any integration adapt to its own scope at runtime.
